command: llvm-mc -triple=riscv64 -filetype=obj RV-P2-addi-imm12.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input, one line each (LF, trailing newline): `addi a0, a1, 1` / `addi a0, a1, -1` / `addi a0, a1, 2047` / `addi a0, a1, -2048`. The last two are the signed imm12 endpoints.
